summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of US solar installation companies sourced from public directories: Solar Power World's annual Top Contractors list, ENF Solar's public installer directory, and NABCEP's certified contractor search. The paid lead market for solar companies charges $0.25-$100 per lead; B2B vendors (solar panel hardware reps, SaaS targeting solar, commercial insurance) need bulk company-level data, not per-homeowner leads. A one-time affordable company directory is the gap.

audience.who: B2B vendors selling to solar installation companies: solar equipment and panel wholesale reps, SaaS tools (CRM, proposal software, permitting tools) targeting solar contractors, commercial insurance brokers, and solar financing companies looking for installer partners.

data_wanted: Company name, state, city, website, phone, email (where publicly listed), market segment (residential/commercial/utility), service type (installer/EPC/developer), NABCEP certification status (where public), solar capacity installed (from SPW rankings where available) — sourced from ENF Solar directory, Solar Power World list, NABCEP directory.

evidence.source: Solar Power World 2025 Top Solar Contractors list — public annual ranking of hundreds of US solar contractors by state and market
evidence.quote: The most recognized annual listing of solar contractors in the United States, companies grouped by specific service, market, and states.

evidence.source: ENF Solar US Installer Directory — public searchable directory of solar installation companies across all 50 states
evidence.quote: Solar System Installers in United States | PV Companies List

evidence.source: LeadsPlease — charges $124.95 per 1,000 solar contractor records, proving buyers pay for bulk solar company data
evidence.quote: Targeted solar leads as downloadable mailing lists for residential and commercial solar installers

evidence.source: Biscred — data-driven solar prospecting product for B2B, proving commercial demand for solar company directories
evidence.quote: Solar Leads in CRE: Data-Driven Prospecting in 2025

willingness_to_pay.signal: LeadsPlease charges $124.95 per 1,000 records. Aged Lead Store prices solar leads at $0.17-$1.50 per record. A one-time download of 2,000-5,000 US solar installer companies priced at $49-99 is 60-80% cheaper per record than incumbent sources and targets the B2B vendor audience (not homeowner leads) that existing providers underserve.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + targeted outreach in r/solar, r/SaaS (for SaaS vendors targeting solar), LinkedIn solar industry groups
first_sale_path.angle: "5,000 US Solar Installation Companies — B2B Database 2026, CSV" — company-level data for vendors who need to sell TO installers, not sell solar TO homeowners. Explicitly positioned against per-homeowner lead providers: 'Not homeowner leads. Company contacts. For people who sell to the solar industry.'
